//: Line-count ceilings for desktop/src, enforced by tests/line-budgets.test.ts. A file listed under `budgets` may not grow past its number (its `wc -l` on the day it was recorded); any file NOT listed may not exceed `default`. When a refactor shrinks a listed file, lower its number in the same commit; when it drops under `default`, delete the line. Raising a number is a reviewed decision, not a fix — say why in the commit. `exempt` files are never counted; each carries its reason.

dev-only workbench registry: every reviewable UI state in one file, never in the shipped bundle
exempt.renderer/dev/workbench/mock-shim.ts: dev-only fake backend for the workbench, never in the shipped bundle
exempt.renderer/dev/workbench/fixtures/marketpl: generated sample of the marketplace registries (regenerated by a script, not hand-edited)
